reason: Pivot step 1.2: the vehicle partition is retired. motor, bicycle, horse and foot were four builds of overlapping ways - bicycle and horse were byte-identical, being the same bridleway data built twice - and they published 109 containers, which froze a phone. They are replaced by ONE dataset, 'ways', classed per way to docs/WAYS-SCHEMA.md. Footpaths (435,299 ways, 627 MB) are not carried: they have no bearing on where a motor vehicle may legally go. Bridleways and restricted byways are carried only within 1 km of a byway open to all traffic (step 1.2c, measured: 15,366 of 89,300 are near one), and every container records context_scope='near-byways-only' with the sentence the app must show, so their absence is never read as absence on the ground. Distinct ways 954,137 rows -> 25,708; every BOAT is kept (10,342 distinct, 12,702 rows across overlapping regions), so nothing a motor rider may legally use has been lost.
